description:
Happy to share that the School Support Project at Bhuvanesh Kirtane School, Mahim, Palghar has been successfully completed. 🙏

200 students from Classes 5 to 8 were provided with:
🎒 School Bags
📦 Compass Boxes
🖊️ Two Pens each

This small gesture will support their education and bring smiles to these young students.

Special thanks to Project Coordinator Rtn. Rajesh Choudhary for his dedicated efforts and heartfelt gratitude to Rtn. Rajesh Choudhary and Rtn. Kishore Mirchandani for completing and supporting this meaningful project.

Thank you both for your valuable contribution towards Service Above Self. 💙School Fees Support for Needy Students
